description: This Java class defines an immutable data structure called SmsCampaignData used for representing SMS campaign information in the Fineract platform. It includes fields for campaign properties, static factory methods for instantiation and templates, and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: SmsCampaignData
classes.description: An immutable data transfer object (DTO) representing an SMS campaign with various configuration options and metadata.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: A static factory method to create a fully populated SmsCampaignData instance with specified campaign details.

methods.name: template
methods.description: A static factory method to create a SmsCampaignData instance initialized with collection options for setup purposes.
